slides.title: It was never your phone's fault.
slides.body: A small sensor in a dark room has two options: hold the shutter open, or turn up the gain. One gives you blur, the other gives you noise. Yours did both.

slides.title: Then it made it worse.
slides.body: Your phone lifts the brightness to compensate, and that is where the *orange* comes from. The magenta wall lights did the rest — that colour is on your face, not your skin.
